title: Custom Made Football Jerseys (2026)
verdict: Wooter is the best source for custom made football jerseys in 2026 if you run a youth, school, 7v7 or flag team. The jersey is built from your design with names and numbers set per player, and matching pants, jackets and compression come in the same order.

Champro is the dealer-ordered alternative with a fitted football cut. Custom Ink works for a flag or intramural team that needs printed jerseys in two weeks. Nike Team is built for programs that plan a season ahead.

ranking.fit: Youth leagues, high school programs and 7v7 teams that want game jerseys, pants and sideline gear in one design.
ranking.lacks: About three weeks to deliver. An August order for a September season is cutting it close.

ranking.fit: Programs with a team dealer that want a fitted, cut-and-sew sublimated jersey.
ranking.lacks: A dealer account places the order, and lead time is confirmed only after artwork approval.

ranking.fit: Flag, intramural and company teams that need names and numbers printed fast.
ranking.lacks: Stock garments with your print added.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and work with an authorized dealer.

why: Football is the sport where a jersey gets grabbed, stretched and washed the most. Decide the cut first: a game jersey sized for pads, or a lighter 7v7 and flag jersey worn without them.
Wooter sells both. Tackle teams get jerseys, pants and jackets. 7v7 teams get jerseys, shorts and compression. Either way it is one design, made in the builder or by a Wooter designer at no charge.
The price shows in the builder as you go, and you pay only when you order.

faq.q: How far ahead should a football team order?
faq.a: Five weeks before the first game is safe: a few days for design and approval, then about three weeks at Wooter. If the date is tight, rush production takes one to two weeks and costs more. Dealer programs like Nike Team need 30 to 90 days.

faq.q: Game jerseys or practice jerseys first?
faq.a: Game jerseys, because they carry the lead time. Practice jerseys can be simpler and ordered later.

faq.q: Can 7v7 and tackle teams share a design?
faq.a: Yes. The design stays the same and the garment changes. Wooter lists football and 7v7 as separate lines.

faq.q: What do we need to place the order?
faq.a: A roster with each player's name, number and size, an approved design and a delivery address. Wooter's roster builder collects it player by player.
One on most items. Wooter's product pages list a minimum quantity of one, and the price per piece drops as the order grows.
